speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of liver disease, alcohol consumption, or recent gastrointestinal bleeding? I would also like to check for physical signs of hepatic encephalopathy, such as asterixis or jaundice.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any abdominal pain, swelling, or nausea, and have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes? I will also check for asterixis and examine your abdomen for signs of ascites. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panels

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal liver function tests, hepatic encephalopathy is unlikely, so I need to investigate other causes like infection or metabolic disturbances. speaker: Doctor
text: I need to rule out metabolic causes and central nervous system issues, so I will check your electrolyte levels and brain structure.
